Anna K.: Quick sync — SI onboarding checklist + HW marketplace readiness for EdgeWave integrators. Who can own the training content + cert track?
Jamal P.: I can take the curriculum outline. Suggest 3 tiers: Intro, Integration, Performance tuning.
Meera S.: +1. We should map each tier to an eval suite and a lab exercise. I can own the evals if someone builds labs.
Lucas M.: Need sandbox GPU access for SIs. Who handles infra ACLs?
Bri: @Lucas M. Partner ops can provision but need a playbook for requests. Also timeline: marketing wants a joint announcement wave in 8 weeks — is that doable? :calendar:
Jamal P.: 8 weeks is tight but possible if we parallelize content + labs. Proposed milestones:
- week 1: curriculum + code samples
- week 2-3: lab build + infra setup
- week 4: internal dry-run with 2 SIs
- week 5: certify first cohort
- week 6-8: joint enablement + co-marketing
Meera S.: Sounds good. I'll draft the cert rubric. Key pass criteria: end-to-end deploy, runtime perf within 20% of baseline, and successful rollback test.
Anna K.: Can we get hardware partner input (EdgeWave) on lab configs? We don't want mismatch on NVLink / instance sizes. @partnership-bot — can you ping EdgeWave contact?
partnership-bot: Pinging EdgeWave: @edgewave-ops — shared playbook draft: https://redwood.share/playbooks/si-edgewave-draft (link).
Lucas M.: For sandbox ACLs, ops-runbook snippet:
```
# grant temporary sandbox
/infra/provision --team=SI-Onboarding --ttl=14d --gpu=4
```
Use tag si-cohort-1.
Bri: Marketing note — keep announcement messaging platform-neutral: focus on "predictable inference at scale" + joint enablement resources. I'll draft co-branded assets.
Anna K.: Action items: Jamal — curriculum outline by Tue. Meera — cert rubric by Wed. Lucas — sandbox runbook + request flow by Fri. Bri — draft marketing copy by next Mon. We'll review in standalone sync on Thursday. :white_check_mark:
Jamal P.: On it.
Meera S.: Will do.
Lucas M.: I'll share request template in #partner-ops.
Bri: Adding checklist to the playbook now. Thanks team! :rocket:
